all-parent-scopes.instructions: Use only the read-only tools exposed for the permissions this connection was granted. It calculates the live UTC-day readiness used by Dashboard Today from current Form/ramp and bounded same-provider sleep baselines. For a broader compact morning readout, use get_daily_briefing; it combines only the latest completed non-nap sleep, current-versus-usual equivalent 28-day Training totals and sport mix, and the compact stored readiness status. Neither tool is a workout plan or medical advice.
